Q: How many moles are in 234 g of NaCl? (Mr of NaCl = 58.5)
A: 4 mol
W: 13,689 mol
W: 0.25 mol
W: 8 mol
E: Moles = mass ÷ molar mass = 234 ÷ 58.5 = 4 mol.

W: 31
W: 15
W: 46
E: Neutrons = mass number − atomic number = 31 − 15 = 16.
